body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgKURKuRGF1ewEVVZKx7U1i4)_

Fixes #27237

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: updated here — skills/objectstack-automation/references/integration-recipes.md, content/docs/automation/connectors.mdx, packages/services/service-automation/README.md
Ruling-ref: #27230 ruling A (comment 6468327468) and S1; #27237 Q3 ruling (comment 6470087293); seat surface call 6469928674

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：新增环境级连接器凭据存储 `sys_connector_credential` 和三条 REST 路由。`credentialRef` 按"环境变量 → 凭据存储 → 注入的解析器"的顺序解析；凭据缺失或被上游拒绝时，只让该实例降级，不再让启动失败。
- 为什么改：托管环境的管理员拿不到服务器环境变量，所以带连接器的应用装上后，凭据永远配不进去（#27230 裁定 A）。
- 风险与回滚：这是行为变化。缺失的 `credentialRef` 和 MCP 的 401/403 都不再让启动失败（见 ADR-0097 修订注记）。rest/openapi 任意一次调用返回 401/403 就会让实例降级，资源级的 403 也算。回滚就是 revert 本 PR，存储表留空无害。
- 先看：`service-automation` 的 `connector-credentials.ts`，以及 `plugin.ts` 里 reconcile 的改动；`runtime` 的 `domains/automation.ts` 里新加的两道门。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run src/connector-credential-door.test.ts`，共 9 项，跑的是真实 SQLite：缺失→降级，PUT→就绪且不重启，环境变量优先，rejected，值不外泄。
- 需要你做的：本 PR 改了 `docs/adr`（Tier H），要等你批准；spec 新增导出还要过合约层评审。

## What changes

**The store.** `sys_connector_credential` is a new engine-owned object in `@objectstack/service-automation`. It is environment-level (`systemFields.tenant: false`, S1), has private access and no generic data door (`apiEnabled: false`). It holds one row per `credentialRef`: `value` is a `Field.secret` (the #7799 seam, so there is no second secret mechanism), plus `revision`, `connector_name`, `package_id`, `status` (`set` / `rejected`), `status_reason` and `last_verified_at`. Writes run under a system context that carries the caller's user id, so the audit stamps record who changed it.

**The chain.** A `credentialRef` resolves from an environment variable of the same name, which always wins. Next comes the stored row, dereferenced through `resolveSecretField`. Last comes the host's injected `credentialResolver` (`connector-credentials.ts`). The value goes only to the provider factory. Nothing else gets it.

**Reconcile on change.** Each instance's signature now includes where its reference resolves from (`env`, `object:<revision>`, `vault`, `missing`). A `PUT` or `DELETE` bumps the revision and runs the reconcile, so exactly the instances naming that reference re-materialize, with no restart.

**Missing → degraded.** A reference no source answers for registers the instance degraded, with a reason that names the reference and the route to set it. It used to be a boot error. A host resolver that throws stays fatal, as before.

**Rejected → degraded.** This follows the Q3 ruling on this card. `@objectstack/spec/integration` gains `ConnectorCredentialRejectedError` / `CONNECTOR_CREDENTIAL_REJECTED` / `isConnectorCredentialRejected`, the twin of the upstream-unavailable marker, with one ledger row (door `none`). `connector-mcp` throws it on a 401/403 at connect, handshake or `tools/list`. For `rest` and `openapi`, the handlers of a credentialed instance are wrapped: the first call that answers 401/403 still returns its answer, and then the instance is degraded. Either way a stored credential is marked `rejected` with the upstream's message, with the value scrubbed (`[credential withheld]`). The instance is held: no timer retry, and no re-attempt until its credential or its declaration changes.

**Routes.** `GET /api/v1/automation/connectors/credential-refs`, plus `PUT` and `DELETE …/credential-refs/:ref`. All three require `manage_metadata`. Under `group` and `isolated` they refuse every caller, the platform operator included, with a 403 that names the posture. The query set is closed (none) and the `PUT` body is the closed `{ value }`. The routes answer with ADR-0112 standard codes only (400 / 404 / 409 / 503, and 501 when the service lacks the optional members), so no new wire code. Each route has a row in the route ledger. `IAutomationService` gains three optional members for them.

**Install-local.** The install answer carries `credentialRefs`: each reference the package's connectors name, with the instances naming it, its status (`unknown` when the listing cannot be read) and its source. It also carries a `credentialNote` naming the ones still to set. An unset reference never refuses the install. For a package that names no credential, the answer's keys are unchanged.

**Docs.** The `credentialRef` section of `content/docs/automation/connectors.mdx` is rewritten, along with the failure table and the README option row. ADR-0097 gets an "Amended by" line, a note under §6 and a note under "Upstream availability" (seat call Q2). The automation skill's integration recipes no longer say an unset reference is a boot error. The tenant-audit census (page and counts ledger, five new write call sites) and the system-context census (row 57b, the door's two `isSystem` reads) are regenerated. There are five changesets, one per published package.

Spec lines, all widening: `contracts/automation-service.ts` gets `ConnectorCredentialRef`, `ConnectorCredentialSetRequest`, `ConnectorCredentialClearRequest` and three optional `IAutomationService` members. `integration/connector-provider-errors.ts` gets `CONNECTOR_CREDENTIAL_REJECTED`, `ConnectorCredentialRejectedError` and `isConnectorCredentialRejected`. `api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts` gets one row. `system/constants/platform-object-names.ts` gets `sys_connector_credential`. Regenerated: `api-surface/{contracts,integration}.json`, `export-origins/{contracts,integration}.json` and three reference pages. Nothing was removed.

## Tests

- `service-automation/src/connector-credential-door.test.ts` runs on real ObjectQL + SQLite with a reversible fake cipher (9 tests). It covers: missing → degraded, naming the ref; set → ready without a restart; set again → re-materialized with the new value; clear → degraded. It covers the 404 / 400 / 404 refusals, which write nothing. It checks the value appears in no log record (the kernel logger at `debug`, stdout+stderr+console captured), the listing, the descriptors, an engine read, or the audit mask set. It checks env wins with `source: env` and a 409 on `PUT`, and the order env → row → vault. Rejected at materialization (the mcp shape) and on the first call (401 and 403) both give degraded + `rejected` + scrubbed + held across a reconcile, and a re-set recovers.
- `runtime/src/domains/automation-connector-credential-door.test.ts` (17 tests) checks: 401 anonymous; 403 without `manage_metadata` on all three verbs; the walled 403 naming the posture for an admin and for the platform operator under `group` and `isolated`; admission under `single` and with no tenancy service; a closed query; a closed body that never echoes; refusal code mapping; a decoded `/` in a ref; 501 without the members.
- `cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-credential-refs.test.ts` (3 tests) and `connector-rest/src/connector-rest-plugin.test.ts`, the latter on the real rest provider: a 401 on a call degrades the instance and scrubs the echoed token.
- Updated to the ruled behaviour: `connector-materialization.test.ts` (missing ref → degraded), `connector-fail-cause.test.ts` (a throwing host resolver stays fatal), `connector-mcp` `mcp-provider.test.ts` / `mcp-http-discovery-faults.test.ts` (401/403 → the marker; a declarative instance degrades, is not retried), and the two object-list equalities.
- Ablation: every negative pin was put back to the forbidden behaviour and watched go red, then restored. Log: the set log carried the value. Listing: an entry carried the resolved value. Descriptors: they spread `def.authentication`. Masked read + audit: `value` became `Field.text`. Scrub: `withoutCredential` became a no-op. Error body: the unknown-key 400 echoed the body.

## Acceptance notes

- **403 is read as a refused credential on rest/openapi, as ruled.** An upstream that answers 403 for a resource-level denial or a rate limit (GitHub's secondary limit is a 403) degrades the instance and marks the credential `rejected` until it is set again.
- **Several replicas.** A write reconciles the replica that took it. Another replica learns of it on its next reconcile (a degraded instance's retry timer, a metadata reload) or at restart. A replica whose instance is live with the old value keeps it until then.
- **Vault-held rejection.** A rejected instance whose value came from the host resolver is held until its declaration changes or a restart. A rotation inside the vault is not observed.
- The api trigger's `secretRef` still resolves through the injected resolver alone (env by default), as before.
- The vault arm needed nothing in objectstack-ai/cloud: it is the existing `credentialResolver` option.
- Premise 5 (hosted runtimes ship the provider plugins) is out of scope and was not measured. I read only that the CLI depends on the three provider packages.

## Verification

Final head `70a67e29`, with `origin/main` merged at `6dc07502`.

- **Gates.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran <record>` reports 128 derived, 128 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, and every exit code is 0. The record mixes runs: the full list ran after the merge, and the docs, skill and changeset gates ran again after the last two docs-only commits. Two gates first exited 3 because a prerequisite was missing. A full `pnpm build` (114/114) and a fetch of the teardown battery's pinned fixture commit met both. Nothing was waived.
- **Fixed on the way.** `check:adr-symbol-anchors`: the auth builder keeps the name `resolveInstanceAuth` that ADR-0143 anchors. `check-tenant-audit-census`: regenerated, with the prose figures restated. `check:doc-authoring`: tracker ids moved out of the ledger note strings. `check:route-ledger-census`: the count goes from 105 to 108. `check:system-context-census`: row 57b. `check-skills-token-ratchet`: the recipe sentence fits the file's ceiling exactly.
- **Tests.** service-automation 2777 passed. runtime 7646 passed, 19 skipped. connector-mcp 46, connector-rest 27, connector-openapi 41, cloud-connection 750. spec 22363 passed, 1 todo. `tsc --noEmit` is clean for service-automation, runtime, connector-mcp and cloud-connection.
- **Lint.** `pnpm lint` (eslint over the whole repo) exits 0.

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
